name: live-voice
description: Hands-free live voice conversation with Claude using local Whisper (STT) and Kokoro (TTS).

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: Kokoro voice used for spoken replies.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language code Whisper transcribes (for example es or en).

echoTailMs.title: Echo tail (ms)
echoTailMs.description: Pause after the reply is spoken before listening again, so the room's echo is not taken for speech.

vadStartFrames.title: Speech start frames
vadStartFrames.description: Consecutive loud 30 ms frames that start an utterance.

vadThresholdFactor.title: Speech threshold factor
vadThresholdFactor.description: How many times louder than the calibrated noise floor speech must be.
